title: 第366章 现在就补偿你第365章 多事之秋
slug: 重生后为当他的皇后杀疯了
content_zh:
这边，樱落和太子齐瀚两个人往回走着。
不过才走了十几步路，便已有两个士兵说，大将军姚战找太子殿下议事。
也是，自从齐煜重伤之后，军中的事务都落到了齐瀚一个人身上。
“太子殿下，你要是公务繁忙的话就去忙吧，我自己一个人能回到房间的！”
樱落知道他是有意要陪着自己，这才开口说道。
“无妨，孤先送你回去，再去找他。”
好吧！
樱落点了点头。
两人并排走着，一时之间谁都没有率先说话。
樱落很是清楚地知道，自己心中有千言万语想要和齐瀚诉说，可如今真有了机会要说的时候，却发现自己什么也说不出来了。
她不禁在心里感念着，自己还真是对感情不开窍呀！
樱落自嘲式的笑了笑，随后说起了正事儿。
“殿下，谢谢你刚刚愿意留下花红婷。其实我知道，以她女子的身份，是很难像无忧哥哥一样留在军中的。可是如今，太子殿下都发话了，谁还敢反驳呀？”
樱落说话十分俏皮，惹得齐瀚轻轻一笑。
“不必谢孤，说起来，孤要感谢你才是。”
就算是时隔多日，可一提起战场上的那件事情，齐瀚仍然是胆战心惊的。
那天战场上发生的事情，就像是一场噩梦。
他眼睁睁的看着自己心爱的女子被敌国掳走，而她会如此，全都是因为他啊！
“樱儿，你知道吗？你原本是不用遭这些罪的，你所做的这一切皆是因为我。若不是因为在战场上，你挡在了我的前面，那么被玉衡国抓走的那个人很有可能就是我了。所以说，你真的不必和孤说谢谢，反而是我应该感谢你才是。”
樱落无所谓了摆了摆手，“太子殿下，你不要这样想，我所做的一切，都是为了我们生生世世相守的诺言，总有一天，你会明白的！”

前世的她历尽千辛万苦，才逆天改命重活一世，与他重逢。
为了齐瀚，樱落可以放弃一切。
可是，齐瀚确实想不明白。
“……什么生生世世相守的诺言？樱儿，孤怎么从来没听你说起过？”
樱落故作神秘的笑着跑开。
“不告诉你！”
齐瀚慌忙跑过去追，他满足地勾起嘴角，掩不住的少年意气，自己都未曾觉察自己在笑。
“樱儿，等这些事情结束了，孤一定要好好奖励奖励你！”
“那你说，你要怎么好好奖励奖励我啊？”
“不告诉你！”
樱落娇嗔着瞪了齐瀚一眼，他变坏了，居然学她，非得这么吊着自己的胃口。
“殿下，你就直说嘛，既然是补偿，那自然得告诉对方啊！不然，人家怎么知道。”
樱落虽是瞪着他，但是眼波中所流露的那种娇羞之色，却委实令齐瀚动心。
齐瀚突然觉得有趣极了，起身靠近了她，话语中噙了一丝暧昧的味道。
“等回宫之后，孤自会好好亲自补偿，之前对你的‘亏欠’。”
他看着樱落的眼神，夹杂了无数的温柔和迷离。
只是可惜，此时此刻的樱落并没有发现这些而已。
若是发现了，她是断然不会问出接下来的话语的。
“啊？有什么就不能现在补偿吗？”
樱落的眼睛不停的在眨巴着，此刻她的心里，也早已经如同猫抓痒痒似的了。

真是的！
有什么就不能在这里明说吗？
“你真的想孤现在就补偿你？”
樱落点了点头。
content_en:
Here, Ying Luo and Prince Qi Han were walking back.
After only a dozen steps, two soldiers already said that General Yao Zhan came to discuss matters with His Highness the Crown Prince.
Also, since Qi Yu was seriously injured, all military affairs have fallen to Qi Han alone.
"Your Highness, if you are busy with official duties, go ahead and do it. I can return to the room by myself!"
Yingluo knew that he intended to accompany her, so she spoke.
"It doesn't matter. I'll send you back first and then go find him."
Okay!
Yingluo nodded.
The two walked side by side, and for a while neither one spoke first.
Yingluo knew very clearly that she had thousands of words in her heart that she wanted to tell Qi Han, but now when she really had the chance to say it, she found that she couldn't say anything.
She couldn't help but feel grateful in her heart, she was really ignorant of feelings!
Ying Luo smiled self-deprecatingly, and then got down to business.
"Your Highness, thank you for your willingness to keep Hua Hongting. In fact, I know that as a woman, it is difficult for her to stay in the army like Brother Wuyou. But now that His Highness the Crown Prince has spoken, who dares to refute?"
Yingluo spoke very playfully, which made Qi Han smile lightly.
"No need to thank Gu, speaking of which, I want to thank you."
Even after many days, Qi Han was still frightened when he mentioned the incident on the battlefield.
What happened on the battlefield that day was like a nightmare.
He watched helplessly as his beloved woman was kidnapped by the enemy country, and she was like this all because of him!
"Ying'er, you know? You didn't have to suffer these crimes originally. Everything you did was because of me. If it weren't for you standing in front of me on the battlefield, then the person captured by Yu Heng Kingdom would probably be me. So, you really don't have to say thank you to Gu. Instead, I should thank you."
Yingluo waved her hand indifferently, "Your Highness, don't think like this. Everything I have done is for the promise that we will keep together for the rest of our lives. One day, you will understand!"
In her previous life, she went through a lot of hardships before changing her fate and resurrecting her life to meet him again.
For Qi Han, Yingluo could give up everything.
However, Qi Han really couldn't understand.
"...What kind of promise will we keep together for eternity? Ying'er, why have I never heard of you talking about it?"
Yingluo pretended to be mysterious and ran away with a smile.
"I won't tell you!"
Qi Han hurriedly ran to catch up. He raised the corners of his mouth with satisfaction, unable to hide his youthful spirit, and he didn't even realize that he was smiling.
"Ying'er, when these things are over, Gu must reward you well!"
"Then tell me, how are you going to reward me properly?"
"I won't tell you!"
Yingluo glared at Qi Han with an angry look. He had become bad and actually imitated her and insisted on swaying her appetite like this.
"Your Highness, just tell me. Since it's compensation, you have to tell the other party! Otherwise, how will others know?"
Although Ying Luo stared at him, the shy look in her eyes really moved Qi Han.
Qi Han suddenly felt very interesting. He stood up and approached her, with a hint of ambiguity in his words.
"After I return to the palace, I will personally make up for my previous 'owe' to you."
The way he looked at Ying Luo was filled with countless tenderness and confusion.
It's a pity that Yingluo didn't notice this at this moment.
If she found out, she would definitely not ask the next words.
"Ah? Is there anything you can't make up for now?"
Yingluo's eyes kept blinking, and at this moment, her heart was already scratching an itch like a cat.
Really!
Is there anything that can't be stated clearly here?
"Do you really want to make it up to you now?"
Yingluo nodded.
